newsitem.title: USA: SAIC has no comment on report it Bellcore suitor.
newsitem.headline: SAIC has no comment on report it Bellcore suitor.

text.p: Science Applications International Corp (SAIC) said it is open to new business opportunities but it declined comment on a report it had agreed to acquire Bellcore for $700 million.

The San Diego, Calif.-based, privately-held defense contractor and systems integration firm was responding to a report in Monday's Wall Street Journal that a pending sale was awaiting approval by Bellcore's existing owners.
Bellcore, the research arm of the seven regional Bell companies, earlier said its board had made no decision about a sale of the company.
In its statement, Science Applications said it "is open to all business opportunities which would be beneficial to our employee owners and the company."
"As a rule, SAIC does not confirm or deny reports regarding its business plans or potential business opportunities," the statement said.
Morristown, N.J.-based Bellcore is jointly owned by Bell Atlantic Corp, Pacific Telesis Group, NYNEX Corp, Ameritech Corp, SBC Communications Inc, BellSouth Corp and U S West Inc.
